subject.title: Import Scrollmark and twitter-web-exporter captures into the canonical local store

question: Should Birdclaw initially support only Scrollmark canonical bundle v1, or also commit to legacy Scrollmark and twitter-web-exporter formats in the first importer?
rationale: Choosing accepted producer schemas and durable provenance semantics creates a long-lived compatibility and storage contract that cannot be inferred safely from existing code.

options.title: Bundle v1 first
options.body: Support the versioned Scrollmark canonical bundle first, with explicit format selection and fixtures, then evaluate legacy exporters separately.

options.title: All proposed formats
options.body: Include canonical bundles, legacy Scrollmark, and twitter-web-exporter in one MVP with broader detection and compatibility obligations.

options.title: Defer core support
options.body: Leave external capture normalization outside Birdclaw until producer schemas and demand stabilize.

recommendation.title: Bundle v1 first
recommendation.body: Support the versioned Scrollmark canonical bundle first, with explicit format selection and fixtures, then evaluate legacy exporters separately.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision governs Birdclaw’s core CLI, canonical storage contract, and long-term external-format compatibility.
